regions.full_page: It was only last night that I came to your letter of the 9th (Febr.), forwarded hither from St. Bonaventure's, Detroit. How wonderful are not the ways of / Lord as well as His works! I surely was pleased with Jack's "Few Years report - almost surpassing my most cherished hopes, that your- self and poor, dear little Mrs. Turrell too had received your First Koly Communion on Christmas. It surely brought a tear to my eye, as even now it does writing about it. I once more am glad to congratulate you on your privilege as on that night I did on long-distance. Of course the same goes for Mrs. Turrell as I felt it did that night. I was surprised after we hung up that I did not ask to speak to her personally to con- gratulate her too, but then I thought; its better instead, that we just turn to God and thank Him, the divine source of such graces, such happi- ness, such consolations. Fortunately I was in St. Bonaventure's that night to receive such tidings and particulars, directly. When I told the others next day at dinner they were more than pleased. Father Salesius especially and the others present who knew you while here in the Bast. When I told them of my pleasant experiences on meeting you two years ago in Los Angeles, how I had gotten in touch (with) Mrs. Turrell, surprising her on the phone and about our "children's Mass next day, Jack, with his details about St. Anthony, so tragicly changing his hesitation to determination, etc; Father Provincial thoughtfully remarked: "That is quite a remarkable case." I've been thinking of late, especially since Jack and you all are so rightly solicitous about his success, even as a manager, God will- ing, - why not? - and especially since Saint Anthony seemed so solicitous himself as to give "his life for Jack's decision" to continue instructions and actually join the true Church, we should go after him with confidence in his intercession and not let him rest till he finish the work he had possibly in his mind when (he) awakened his protege,

regions.full_page: God bless you Doctor Turrell - you and yours - and keep you in His holy grace and guide us all to the one great goal where love God and our neighbor is the life and the very soul of society and association, where hopefull faith has merged into eternal charity.
